{"type": "edit", "path": "matrix.py", "content": "def transpose(matrix: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Transpose a 2D matrix."""
    if not matrix or not matrix[0]:
        return []
    rows = len(matrix)
    cols = len(matrix[0])
    return [[matrix[r][c] for r in range(rows)] for c in range(cols)]
"}
